author: @newsmax
title: Los Angeles County Sues Southern California Edison Over Eaton Fire
text:
• Los Angeles County is suing Southern California Edison.
• The lawsuit alleges that Edison’s equipment sparked the Eaton Fire in January 2025.
• The Eaton Fire destroyed over 9,400 structures and resulted in 17 fatalities in the Altadena area.
• The lawsuit seeks to recover costs and damages related to the fire.
• Damages include impacts on community infrastructure, natural resources, environment, wildlife, and public health.
• Additional costs have been incurred by county departments for ongoing support to residents affected by the fire.
• The county's case aims to aid in the restoration and rebuilding of the community.
• Edison is currently reviewing the lawsuit and will respond through legal channels.
• The cause of the fire remains under investigation.
• The complaint cites witness accounts, photos, and videos indicating the fire started under Edison transmission lines in Eaton Canyon.
• The county is seeking compensation for various damages, including infrastructure, recreational areas, road damage, and recovery efforts.
• Cost estimates for damages are expected to reach hundreds of millions of dollars, with assessments ongoing.
• County Counsel Dawyn R. Harrison emphasized the commitment to seeking justice for the Altadena community.
• The county, Flood Control District, and Consolidated Fire Protection District are plaintiffs in the case.
• Cities of Pasadena and Sierra Madre are also filing lawsuits against Edison for damages related to the Eaton Fire.
